svg.title: Rekognition detect labels
svg.desc: A React site loads from CloudFront, gets a presigned upload form from an HTTP API, uploads an image straight to S3, and subscribes to an AppSync Events channel. An ObjectCreated notification invokes the detect function, which calls Rekognition DetectLabels, caches the result in DynamoDB, and publishes it to the channel.
